build_bifpn_backbone: build a BiFPN backbone with ResNet bottom-up and configurable top levels for FCOS object detection
create_singlebifpn_module: create a SingleBiFPN module that fuses multi-scale features using attention-weighted combinations and 3x3 convolutions
build_feature_map_resampler: build a FeatureMapResampler to downsample feature maps with optional channel reduction and max pooling
build_backbone_with_top_levels: build a BackboneWithTopLevels wrapper that adds extra P6 and P7 feature levels to any backbone
build_dla_bifpn_backbone: build a BiFPN backbone using DLA-34 as the bottom-up network for FCOS detection with P3 to P7 levels
